home.betaHint: Early access — fully usable, still being polished.
home.comingSoonCard: We're building this for you — it'll be available right here soon.

nav.comingSoon: Coming soon — this module is on the way.

createWorkspace.title: Start a {{service}} workspace
createWorkspace.subtitle: Your country, currency and free plan are set automatically — just name it.
createWorkspace.nameHint: Usually your business or brand name. You can rename it later.
createWorkspace.limitReached: The free plan includes one workspace per service. Paid plans with more workspaces are coming soon.

modulesSoon.title: Your tools are on the way
modulesSoon.hint: Inbox, campaigns and more unlock as we roll out each module.
modulesSoon.body: Connect-and-send arrives with the next updates — this workspace is ready and waiting.

plan.title: Your plan
plan.hint: Features and limits come from your plan — they update instantly when your plan changes.
plan.noFeatures: Nothing listed — features unlock with paid plans.
plan.upgradeSoon: Plan upgrades arrive with billing — soon you'll switch plans right here.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.hint: Reserved balance for a future Solution Partner path. WhatsApp conversations are billed by Meta on your WABA; we bill only your CRM subscription.

connect.label: Connect your WhatsApp Business Account
connect.description: Use Facebook Login to link your WABA so you can send and receive messages.

metaPay.label: Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
metaPay.description: Meta bills conversation fees directly to your WABA — not to us. Add a card or bank account in Meta's WhatsApp Manager to enable sending.

firstTemplate.label: Create your first message template
firstTemplate.description: Approved templates let you start conversations with customers. Templates go through Meta's review (usually minutes to hours).

firstSend.label: Send your first message
firstSend.description: Once a template is approved and your Meta payment method is set, you're ready to send.

WABA_NOT_CONNECTED.title: Connect your WhatsApp Business Account first
WABA_NOT_CONNECTED.body: You'll need to complete the WhatsApp Embedded Signup to link a WABA before you can use this feature.

META_PAYMENT_REQUIRED.title: Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
META_PAYMENT_REQUIRED.body: Meta charges conversation fees directly on your WhatsApp Business Account — not through us. You need a valid payment method in Meta's WhatsApp Manager before you can send messages.
META_PAYMENT_REQUIRED.note: This is separate from your Start Messaging CRM subscription.

META_BILLING_ERROR.title: Meta could not process the conversation charge
META_BILLING_ERROR.body: Your WhatsApp Business Account has a billing issue. Update your payment method in Meta's WhatsApp Manager to resume sending.
META_BILLING_ERROR.note: Meta billing and your CRM subscription are independent — this doesn't affect your account here.

OUTSIDE_CUSTOMER_CARE_WINDOW.title: Outside the 24-hour messaging window
OUTSIDE_CUSTOMER_CARE_WINDOW.body: WhatsApp only allows free-form replies within 24 hours of a customer's last message. To contact this customer now, send an approved template instead.

TEMPLATE_NOT_APPROVED.title: Template not approved yet
TEMPLATE_NOT_APPROVED.body: This template is pending review or was rejected by Meta. Check the Templates page for the current status and any rejection reasons.

PHONE_QUALITY_LIMIT.title: Phone number quality limit reached
PHONE_QUALITY_LIMIT.body: Your WhatsApp number has received too many blocks or reports and has hit a throughput limit. Slow or pause sends while quality recovers — usually within 24–48 hours.

PLAN_FEATURE_REQUIRED.title: Feature not included in your plan
PLAN_FEATURE_REQUIRED.body: This feature is available on paid CRM plans. Upgrade your Start Messaging subscription to unlock it.

SUBSCRIPTION_PAST_DUE.title: Your CRM subscription is past due
SUBSCRIPTION_PAST_DUE.body: Some features are locked until your subscription is renewed. Update your payment method on the Billing page to restore access.

WABA_DISCONNECTED.title: WhatsApp Business Account disconnected
WABA_DISCONNECTED.body: Your WABA has been disconnected or the access token is no longer valid. Reconnect via Embedded Signup to restore messaging.

connect.title: Connect WhatsApp
connect.subtitle: Link your WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) to start sending and receiving messages.

intro.title: How it works
intro.body: We use Meta's Embedded Signup to securely connect your Facebook Business and WhatsApp Business Account. You'll be asked to log in with Facebook and choose or create a WABA.
intro.metaBillingNote: After connecting, you must add a payment method in Meta's WhatsApp Manager. Meta charges conversation fees directly — separate from your CRM subscription here.

connected.title: WhatsApp connected
connected.body: Your WABA is linked. Follow the checklist below to complete your setup.

pin.title: Enter your 2-step verification PIN
pin.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit PIN you set for this WhatsApp Business phone number. This is required to complete registration.
pin.sessionMissing: Session info not received from Facebook — please try connecting again.
pin.pendingBody: Your WABA is linked, but the business number still needs its 6-digit Cloud API PIN before you can send messages.
pin.registered: Phone registered — you can send messages now

metaPayChecklist.title: Next: add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
metaPayChecklist.body: Meta bills WhatsApp conversation fees on your WABA — not through Start Messaging. You must add a credit card or bank account in Meta's WhatsApp Manager before your first send.
metaPayChecklist.note: This is separate from your Start Messaging CRM plan.

sync.hint: Connection updates normally arrive via webhooks. Use refresh if you changed the number or WABA in Meta and status looks wrong.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.subtitle: All your WhatsApp conversations in one place.

intro.title: Your conversation inbox
intro.body: Incoming messages appear here in real time. Within 24 hours of a customer's last message you can reply freely; after that, use an approved template to re-open the conversation.

empty.title: No conversations yet
empty.body: Once customers message you or you send a template, their replies will appear here.

thread.selectHint: Choose a conversation on the left to view messages and reply.
thread.empty: No messages yet — send the first one below.

composer.textPlaceholder: Type a message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line)
composer.noApprovedTemplates: No approved templates yet. Create and get one approved in Templates first.
composer.paramsHint: Fill the variables Meta requires for this template:
composer.paramRequired: Enter a value for {{n}} before sending.
composer.deliveryFailed: Message failed to deliver. Check the bubble for Meta’s reason.

notifications.enableHint: Get notified when new WhatsApp messages arrive — even if this tab is closed (web push).
notifications.needPushToken: Browser permission is on, but web push is not registered yet (often blocked by untrusted HTTPS). Click to retry after mkcert -install.
notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked — allow them in your browser settings.
notifications.newMessageBody: You have a new message in your inbox.
notifications.enabled: Push notifications enabled for this browser.

newConversation.title: Start a new conversation
newConversation.subtitle: Enter the customer's WhatsApp number to create or open their thread. You'll send a template to start.
newConversation.name: Contact name (optional)
newConversation.phoneMin: Enter a valid phone number (at least 7 digits)
newConversation.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number including country code (e.g. +91 98765 43210)
newConversation.nationalNumberDigits: Digits only — no spaces or symbols

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Pre-approved messages for starting or re-opening conversations.

intro.title: What are message templates?
intro.body: Templates are pre-approved message formats required by Meta to initiate conversations or reply after the 24-hour customer care window. They go through Meta's review (typically minutes to a few hours for most categories).

empty.title: No templates yet
empty.body: Start from an example below, or create a blank template. Only Meta-approved templates can be sent outside the 24-hour window.

examples.title: Start from an example
examples.subtitle: Curated Meta-style recipes by category. Apply to customize, then submit to Meta for review — we don’t approve templates.
examples.footer: {{count}} starters · not live until you submit to Meta

templates.deleteBody: "{{name}}" will be deleted from Meta and removed here. This cannot be undone.

create.title: Create message template
create.subtitle: Templates must be approved by Meta before use. Review takes minutes to a few hours.
create.name: Template name
create.nameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores only (e.g. order_confirmation).
create.nameInvalid: Only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores are allowed.
create.headerPlaceholder: Short title shown above the body
create.bodyPlaceholder: Hello {{1}}, your order {{2}} has been confirmed.
create.bodyHint: Use {{1}}, {{2}} … for dynamic variables. We attach Meta sample values automatically. Max 1,024 characters.
create.footerPlaceholder: e.g. Reply STOP to opt out
create.componentsNote: Header and footer are included in the payload Meta reviews.
create.previewEmpty: Your message will appear here as you type
create.previewCaption: Visual only — variables show sample values

rejection.INVALID_FORMAT: Invalid format — body/header variables need sample values (we now send these automatically). Delete and resubmit.
rejection.ABUSIVE_CONTENT: Rejected for abusive or prohibited content.
rejection.INCORRECT_CATEGORY: Wrong category — try Utility vs Marketing.

intro.title: Manage your contacts
intro.body: Import or add phone numbers to build your audience. Contacts must have opted in to receive messages from your business.

empty.title: No contacts yet
empty.body: Import a CSV or add contacts one by one to get started.

add.title: Add a contact
add.subtitle: Add a WhatsApp number to your audience. Pick the country, then enter the local number.
add.phoneHint: Country dial code is selected separately — enter the local number only.
add.nationalNumberDigits: Digits only — no spaces or symbols
add.name: Contact name (optional)
add.duplicate: A contact with this number already exists.

import.title: Import contacts
import.subtitle: Upload a CSV to bulk-add contacts to your audience.
import.hint: First column: phone in E.164 format (e.g. +919876543210). Second column: name (optional). Row 1 is treated as a header and skipped.
import.skippedHint: Skipped rows have duplicate numbers or are not valid E.164 numbers.
import.errorParsing: Could not read the file — make sure it is a valid UTF-8 CSV.

delete.title: Remove contact?
delete.body: {{name}} will be removed from your contact list. Existing conversations are not affected.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Send template messages to your audience at scale.

intro.title: Reach your audience
intro.body: Campaigns let you send approved templates to lists of opted-in contacts. Conversation fees are billed by Meta on your WABA — not through us.

empty.title: No campaigns yet
empty.body: Create a campaign to send a template to your contact list.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: Your Start Messaging CRM subscription.

intro.title: CRM subscription vs. Meta billing
intro.body: Your Start Messaging subscription covers access to the CRM — inbox, templates, campaigns, contacts and team features. WhatsApp conversation fees are billed separately by Meta on your WABA.

billing.upgradeSoon: Plan upgrades with Razorpay billing arrive soon.
billing.metaBillingNote: WhatsApp conversation fees go directly to Meta — not to Start Messaging. Manage your WABA payment method in Meta's WhatsApp Manager.

noSubscription.title: No active subscription
noSubscription.body: You're on the free plan. Upgrade to unlock inbox, campaigns, contacts, and more.

errors.OTP_LOCKED: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.MOBILE_INVALID: That doesn't look like a valid mobile number.

errors.MOBILE_TAKEN: That mobile number is already in use.
errors.MOBILE_ALREADY_VERIFIED: Your mobile number is already verified.

errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_VERIFIED: This email is already verified — just sign in.
errors.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: You've reached your plan's limit. Upgrade for more.
errors.SERVICE_NOT_AVAILABLE: This service is not available in your country yet.
errors.PLAN_NOT_CONFIGURED: This service isn’t accepting new workspaces right now. Please try again later.

errors.CANNOT_MODIFY_OWNER: The workspace owner can't be changed.

errors.INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to a different email.
errors.INVITE_INVALID: This invitation is invalid or has expired.
errors.INVITE_PENDING: An invitation for that email is already pending.
errors.WABA_NOT_CONNECTED: Connect your WhatsApp Business Account first.
errors.WABA_DISCONNECTED: Your WhatsApp Business Account has been disconnected. Please reconnect.
errors.META_PAYMENT_REQUIRED: Add a payment method to your WhatsApp Business Account in Meta's WhatsApp Manager.

errors.OUTSIDE_CUSTOMER_CARE_WINDOW: The 24-hour messaging window has closed. Use an approved template to re-open the conversation.
errors.TEMPLATE_NOT_APPROVED: This template hasn't been approved by Meta yet. Check the Templates page for status.
errors.TEMPLATE_PENDING_APPROVAL: This template is still pending Meta review. Wait until it shows Approved.
errors.TEMPLATE_REJECTED: Meta rejected this template. Check the rejection reason on the Templates page.
errors.TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: That template was not found. Sync from Meta or create it first.
errors.PHONE_QUALITY_LIMIT: Your phone number has hit a Meta throughput limit. Slow sends until quality recovers.
errors.PHONE_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED: WhatsApp messaging limit reached for this number. Try again later.
errors.MESSAGE_UNDELIVERABLE: WhatsApp could not deliver this message to the recipient number.
errors.PLAN_FEATURE_REQUIRED: Upgrade your Start Messaging CRM plan to use this feature.
errors.SUBSCRIPTION_PAST_DUE: Your CRM subscription is past due. Update your payment on the Billing page.
errors.CONTACT_DUPLICATE: A contact with this phone number already exists in your workspace.
